scope: Directory organization, environment creation, saved-result rendering and verification; no model fitting
preservation: All scientific inputs and result artifacts retained locally; raw results and superseded runs under results/ are Git-ignored.

checks.syntax: All scripts/*.py parsed and scripts/*.sh passed bash -n
checks.render: All main and supplementary figures rendered from saved results; GO table and marker figure exported separately
checks.manuscript: Seven central PDFs validated; hashes in results/manuscript/figure_sources.json

reproduction_limits: Historical full-cortex L1 input checksum and original per-panel timings cannot be reconstructed by fresh ranking runs.
Original historical cortex-noise fitting producer is not fully preserved; saved outcomes and PCA are reproducible.
Original historical MERFISH recipe is missing; the current explicit five-fold refit is reproducible.
Input/result bundles, Gurobi license, local fonts and a TeX installation for manuscript compilation must be supplied separately.
